name: Creative Expression and Performance
notes: The dance BA offers two concentrations: Creative Expression and Performance, and Dance Studies. Each is encoded as its own program here because the university's program list names them separately.
This concentration comprises at least 54 credits.

Requirements are stated in CREDITS, and many DANC courses are 1-2 credits rather than 4. Each group below converts its credit minimum into a course count using the modal credit value of that group's own option list; a student who picks larger or smaller courses will need fewer or more than the count shown. Confirm credit totals with the program.

CREDIT GAP - NEEDS VERIFICATION: the five stated category minimums sum to 46 credits (8 foundations + 16 embodied practice + 12 critical thinking + 6 somatic awareness + 4 seminar), but the concentration is stated as at least 54 credits. About 8 further credits of dance coursework are needed beyond the category minimums modeled here.
Courses that appear in more than one category can only be used to fulfill one category (the groups below do not share courses).

Foundations lists an OPTIONAL fourth bullet - 'choose up to one' of DANC 170, DANC 241/242, or DANC 288 (4 credits). It is not modeled as required because DANC 160 + DANC 278 + DANC 241/242 already meets the 8-credit foundations minimum.

Seminar/capstone also lists optional courses DANC 260 (Interdisciplinary Dance Studies) and DANC 391 (Independent Study); the senior capstone may be a paper, project, service or community-based activity, choreography and/or performance.
NOT A COURSE REQUIREMENT: Experience in Technical Production - students must complete one red job (13+ hours), one yellow job (6-12 hours) and one green job (0-5 hours) on program productions.
NOT A COURSE REQUIREMENT: students enrolled in any dance course must attend at least two program-sponsored performances and two program-sponsored workshops each semester.

The catalog splits DANC 250 (Contemporary Dance: Context and Practice) into sections DANC 250A and DANC 250B; both are listed as options wherever the page says DANC 250. Likewise DANC 365 is catalogued as DANC 365A/B/C.

requirementGroups.label: Foundations
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Required Courses Foundations - Minimum of 8 credits required: DANC 160: Dance Improvisation (2 credits) (Suggested as a pre-req to Choreography); DANC 278: Choreography (4 credits)

requirementGroups.label: Dance production or lighting design
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: DANC 241: Introduction to Dance Production (4 credits) or DANC 242: Lighting Design for Dance (2 credits)

requirementGroups.label: Embodied practice: two 4-credit practice courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Embodied Practice - Minimum of 16 credits required. Students are required to take at least 16 credits of embodied practice courses. Choose two or more courses: DANC 204: Contact Improvisation and Culture (4 credits); DANC 250: Contemporary Dance: Context and Practice (4 credits); DANC 251: Jazz Dance: Context and Practice (4 credits); DANC 252: Intermediate Ballet: Context and Practice (4 credits); DANC 253: West African Dance: Context and Practice (4 credits); DANC 254: Tap Dance in American History: Context and Practice (4 credits); DANC 285: Experience Guinea (4 credits)
requirementGroups.note: Every course in this list is 4 credits, so two of them supply 8 of the 16 required embodied-practice credits.

requirementGroups.label: Embodied practice: remaining 8 credits
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Additional embodied practice courses: DANC 110; DANC 116; DANC 126; DANC 140; DANC 145; DANC 150; DANC 171; DANC 181; DANC 182; DANC 185; DANC 187; DANC 188; DANC 189; DANC 190; DANC 197; DANC 212/MUR 210; DANC 215; DANC 240; DANC 266; DANC 267; DANC 268; DANC 269; DANC 271; DANC 273; DANC 281; DANC 283; DANC 290; DANC 365
requirementGroups.note: Almost every course here is 2 credits, so four of them supply the remaining 8 embodied-practice credits. Two more 4-credit courses from the list above would do the same; the additional list is not mandatory.

requirementGroups.label: Critical thinking: creative expression (4 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Critical Thinking - Minimum of 12 credits. All dance majors are required to present work and/or participate in public performance through one or more of the following courses. Choose at least four credits in each of the following required categories for a total of 12 credits. Creative expression (choose at least 4 credits): DANC 104 (2); DANC 109 (2); DANC 237 (2); DANC 243/SART 243/FMST 223/DMST 281 (4); DANC 279 (1); DANC 377 (4); DANC 378 (4); DANC 379 (4); DANC 380 (3); DANC 385 (2); DANC 397 (1)
requirementGroups.note: This list mixes 1-4 credit courses; the 4-credit options are listed first because one of them satisfies the category outright. Picking smaller courses means taking more of them to reach 4 credits.

requirementGroups.label: Critical thinking: citizenship (4 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Citizenship (choose at least 4 credits): DANC 202: Dance and Peacebuilding (4 credits); DANC 233: Climate Interventions: Performing Arts + New Media (4 credits); DANC 247: Moving Memories (4 credits); DANC 249: The Art of Dance, Change, and Community Practice (4 credits); DANC 296: The Art of Teaching Dance (4 credits); DANC 305: Dance and Interdependent Community (4 credits); DANC 235: Change: Welcomed, Denied, Inevitable (4 credits)

requirementGroups.label: Critical thinking: context and cultural competency (4 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Context and cultural competency (choose at least 4 credits): DANC 155: Social Dance: A Cultural History (4 credits); DANC 195: World Dance (4 credits); DANC 228: Dance History: Philosophy, Aesthetics and Culture (4 credits); DANC 248: Arts and Activism (4 credits)

requirementGroups.label: Somatic awareness anchor
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Somatic Awareness - Minimum of 6 credits required. Choose at least one of the following: DANC 200: Anatomy and Kinesiology (4 credits); DANC 230: Living Anatomy, Living Yoga (4 credits)

requirementGroups.label: Somatic awareness: remaining 2 credits
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Additional somatic awareness courses: DANC 106: Pilates (1 credit); DANC 114: Intro to Yoga (2 credits); DANC 115: Moving Into Stillness (2 credits); DANC 130: Conditioning for the Dancer and Athlete (2 credits); DANC 167: Ecolinguistics: Language and Movement (4 credits); DANC 170: Embodied Resourcing Through Somatic Practices (4 credits); DANC 208: Tai Chi: Movement Art and Culture (2 credits); DANC 209: Qi Gong Way to Health (2 credits); DANC 211: Tai Chi: Explorations in Qi (4 credits); DANC 218: Into the Present Moment (4 credits); DANC 225: Yoga II: Continuing the Journey (2 credits); DANC 245: Dance/Movement Therapy Foundations (4 credits); DANC 258: Resilient Activism Embodied Practices for Effective Systemic Change (2 credits); DANC 288: Movement Analysis and Integration (4 credits)
requirementGroups.note: One 2-credit course from this list completes the 6-credit somatic-awareness minimum on top of the 4-credit anchor above.

requirementGroups.label: Senior seminar/capstone (4 credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Seminar/Capstone Courses - 4 credits required. DANC 388W: Senior Seminar A (fall) and DANC 389W: Senior Seminar B (spring) /Project* (4 credits total; 2 in fall semester and 2 in spring semester, starting fall 2023)

upperLevelWriting.label: Senior seminar pairing (DANC 388W + DANC 389W)
upperLevelWriting.note: The department states the upper-level writing requirement is built into the array of courses in the dance major, and that DANC 388W/389W is where the requirement is formally attended to: students submit drafts and receive feedback before the final senior thesis is due.
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: The upper-level writing requirement is built into the array of courses in the dance major, where reflective and research-based writing is inherent. ... DANC 388W Senior Seminar A (fall) and DANC 389W Senior Seminar B (spring) is where we pay attention to the writing requirement.
